summary: Pharming Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting that the U.S. FDA accepted its resubmitted sNDA for Joenja (leniolisib) to treat children aged 4-11 years with APDS. The resubmission follows a Complete Response Letter and a Type A meeting. It seeks approval for 40 mg and 50 mg twice-daily dosing in patients weighing >=27 kg, with a PDUFA date of October 24, 2026. No deal terms, prices, or special-situation mechanics are involved. This is a regulatory update, not a special situation.
